title: Story premise ENT030: The Last Patch of Shade
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (cooperation). Hook: There is enough shade, just in the wrong shape. Takeaway/theme: Changing the geometry can change who fits.
description: Three travelers compete to fit beneath one tiny floating shade disc, repeatedly leaving someone exposed in the story’s harsh stylized sun. They stop crowding under it and use three sticks to tilt the disc toward a nearby wall, creating one long stripe of shade where all can rest.
